title: Trove calendar change
description: One line of calendar/changes/YYYY-MM.jsonl: an append-only diff observed by a sync — added / changed / removed. The unrecoverable history layer (the occurrence store always reflects the present). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time of the sync that observed the change

occurrence.description: instance slot, as in the snapshot (RFC3339 local)

title.description: event title — a thumbnail for context without a snapshot join

start.description: RFC3339 local start — a thumbnail for context without a snapshot join

calendar.description: calendar name — a thumbnail for context without a snapshot join

field.description: name of the field that drifted

old.description: the field's previous raw JSON value

new.description: the field's new raw JSON value

changes.description: only on "changed": exactly the fields that drifted, each {field, old, new}
